did.unittitle: Nelson A. Rockefeller personal papers, Mary M. Kresky, Room 5600 files, Series S

physdesc.extent: 66 archival boxes including: 20 letter document boxes, 36 legal document boxes, 8 index card file boxes, 1 oversized flat box, 1 standard record storage box.

accessrestrict.head: Conditions Governing Access
accessrestrict.p: Open for research with select materials restricted as noted. Brittle or damgaged items available at the discretion of RAC.

userestrict.head: Conditions Governing Use
userestrict.p: The Rockefeller Archive Center has title, copyright, and literary rights in the collection, in so far as it holds them, and has authority to grant permission to cite and publish archival material from the collection.

processinfo.head: Processing Information
processinfo.p: Expedited Access - Processing Level 1 - File-Level Access.
Some records remain in original file folders. Additional processing will be conducted in the future to improve description, enhance access, and long-term preservation.

arrangement.head: Arrangement
arrangement.p: Loosely arranged by creator or subject/topic.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: This series of Mary M. Kresky files documents Nelson A. Rockefeller's personal interests and activities through files maintained in the Rockefeller family office, Room 5600, Rockefeller Center, 30 Rockefeller Plaza, New York City.
In addition to Mary Kresky, prominent Nelson A. Rockefeller office staff, aides, and associates include: Louise Boyer, Kathy Huldrum, Hugh Morrow, Dick Parsons, and George Taylor.
